ambient: The reader reaches the bottom of you and pauses.
A finger comes to rest somewhere near your middle.
The light on you changes, because a lamp was adjusted.
description: You are a page a long way into a book, and somebody is reading you, and you have been the same eleven words for a very long time. The reading is unhurried. When the page turns you will go with it and stop being a page, and you have no view about that.
name: The Page

looks: Eleven of them. You have been them for the whole afternoon.
They are about something else entirely, which does not matter.
One of them is doing most of the work.
objects.name: the words on you

looks: Not visible. Present at the edge, the way weather is present.
They are near the bottom of you, and slowing.
They have been at this all day and they are enjoying it.
objects.name: the reader

weather: There is a lamp on, and it is raining somewhere well outside the book.
